product_name: FC-C (豪华型) 通过式金属检测门
summary: FC-C 金属探测门是一种检测人员有无携带金属物品的探测装置，又称金属探测安检门。它广泛应用于监狱、法院、博物馆、图书馆、医院、学校、电子厂、港口、高铁站、演唱会及大型会议等人流较大的公共场所。该设备专门用于检查人体隐藏的危险金属物品，如枪支、管制刀具等，确保高敏感区域的公共安全。
summary_en: The FC-C metal detection gate is a specialized security device designed to detect whether personnel are carrying metallic objects. Widely known as a walk-through metal detector, it is extensively deployed in prisons, courts, museums, libraries, hospitals, schools, electronic factories, ports, and high-speed rail stations. It is also an essential screening tool for concert venues and large conferences, effectively identifying hidden dangerous items such as firearms and controlled knives to ensure the highest level of public safety in high-traffic environments.
key_application: 应用领域：FC-C(豪华型)通过式金属探测门；广泛应用于人流较大的公共场所及高敏感区域，用于检查人身体上隐藏的危险金属物品。
key_application_en: High-precision security screening for airports, stations, and government buildings; 12-zone independent alarm display; adjustable 1000-level sensitivity; robust anti-interference and vibration resistance.
key_parameter_1: 探测区域: 12个互相重叠的网状探测区

parameters.探测防区: 12个独立防区，单区或多区同时显示物品位置
parameters.灵敏度等级: 0-1000级可调，最高可探至一枚回形针大小
parameters.抗干扰能力: 采用 1000 级 DSP 数字过滤，具有超强磁电兼容性
parameters.材质工艺: ABS 材质门体，配置铝合金支柱与防水防火板
parameters.统计功能: 微型计算机控制，自动统计通过人数与报警次数
parameters.安全性: 符合弱磁场技术标准，对起搏器、孕妇、磁性介质无害
parameters.并网能力: 12个工作频点，支持多台并排使用（间距仅35mm）
parameters.工作频率: 可根据安装环境自行无级调节

parameters_en.Detection Zones: 12 independent overlapping zones with multi-target display
parameters_en.Sensitivity Range: 0-1000 adjustable levels; detects items as small as a paperclip
parameters_en.Anti-interference: 1000-level DSP digital filtering for superior electromagnetic compatibility
parameters_en.Construction: ABS housing with aluminum alloy supports and waterproof/flame-retardant panels
parameters_en.Intelligence: Microcomputer-controlled automatic traffic and alarm counting
parameters_en.Health Safety: Weak magnetic field technology; safe for pacemakers and pregnant women
parameters_en.Frequency Adjustment: Infinitely adjustable based on installation environment

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 12定位探测区：通过网状覆盖实现人体的多维度扫描，高清LED指示灯实时显示违禁品在左右立柱的确切高度及防区。
  • 高精密算法：核心采用DSP数字信号处理技术，具备1000级超敏度调节，可轻松排除钥匙、皮带扣干扰，锁定微型刀具。
  • 全天候工业设计：门体采用ABS复合防火材料，具备优良的抗腐蚀与耐划伤性能，配有底部防水固定件。
  • 极致抗干扰：专有的脉冲电磁场技术与平衡式感知设计，单机仅需35mm间距即可并排作业，互不干扰信号。
  • 智能化数据管理：内置高精度客流量统计器，掉电后自动保存通过人数与历史报警日志。
  • 符合国际安全规范：严格执行EN50081-1辐射标准与EN50082-1抗干扰标准，确保对磁性存储介质及特殊人群的安全。
  • Figure 1 Walk-Through Metal Detector
detail_html_en:
Features

  • 12-Zone Precision Tracking: overlapping detection mesh provides accurate vertical and horizontal localization of threats, indicated by high-brightness LEDs on both pillars.
  • Intelligent Sensitivity Control: featuring 1000 sensitivity increments to precisely mask common metal items like coins or jewelry while pinpointing prohibited weapons.
  • Industrial-Grade Build: constructed from high-strength ABS and flame-retardant materials, featuring a moisture-resistant base for reliable performance in humid transitional areas.
  • Scalable Deployment: with 12 separate frequency channels, multiple gates can operate within a 35mm proximity without cross-signal interference.
  • Traffic Intelligence: automated microcomputer logic counts passenger flow and alarm instances, providing key usage metrics for facility management.
  • Medical & Media Safe: utilizes ultra-low magnetic field principles, fully compatible with modern medical implants and high-density magnetic storage media.
